provenance.clerk_text: Filed 45 years of monthly precipitation (Precipitation Corrected, mm/day) for Northern Yucatan, Mexico, 1981-01 to 2025-12, averaged over 9 points. Source: NASA POWER Monthly & Annual API, accessed 2026-11-14.

verdict.label: inconclusive
verdict.reason: The test cannot tell this trend from noise (p = 0.498), and this record's noise makes its interval too optimistic to rule out a trend.
